# @kayjs/tailwind Reference

> Tailwind CSS v4 integration plugin for Kay v2 via `bun-plugin-tailwind`.

## Imports

- `@kayjs/tailwind`: `tailwind(options?)`; type `TailwindPluginOptions`.

## Setup

Install `tailwindcss` and `bun-plugin-tailwind` in your app (`bun add -d tailwindcss bun-plugin-tailwind`), then register `tailwind()` in `kay.config.ts`:

- `css`: global stylesheet entry path relative to project root (default `'src/app.css'`).
- `bunPlugin`: optional `BunPlugin` override (auto-resolved from `bun-plugin-tailwind` when omitted).
- `kay check`: reports an error if `bun-plugin-tailwind` cannot be resolved and no `bunPlugin` was passed.

## Snippets

```ts
// kay.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@kayjs/kay/config'
import { tailwind } from '@kayjs/tailwind'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [tailwind()], // defaults to css: 'src/app.css'
})
```

```css
/* src/app.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
```
